data.name: Ratikanta
data.long_meaning: Ratikanta is a Sanskrit name which means 'Ruler of the night'. This name is derived from the Hindu god Ratri, the goddess of the night. The name is bestowed upon a child who is believed to have the qualities of a ruler, such as strength, courage, and loyalty.
